title: Spread a local scheme morphism from a Noetherian source
statement: Let $S,T,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $a:T\to S$ and $g:Z\to S$ morphisms, with $T$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $g$ locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $t\in T$, and let $c_t:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{T,t}\to T$ be the canonical morphism [lem-weil-pbc-spec-local-ring-canonical-morphism]. For every morphism $\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{T,t}\to Z$ satisfying $g\circ\varphi=a\circ c_t$, there exist an open neighbourhood $W\subseteq T$ of $t$ and a morphism $h:W\to Z$ such that $g\circ h=a|_W$ and $h\circ c_{t,W}=\varphi$, where $c_{t,W}:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{T,t}\to W$ is the factorization of $c_t$ through $W$.
